shapes.provider_abi: SGLang API-v1 flashmla_sparse_decode main plus combine

baseline_kernel: installed sgl-kernel 0.4.4 FlashMLA SM100 flash_fwd_splitkv_mla_fp8_sparse_kernel plus flash_fwd_mla_combine_kernel

bottleneck.evidence: Prior production NCU evidence identified sparse-gather long-scoreboard and barrier pressure with no spill bottleneck. In this campaign, direct FP8 conversion and exact-contract specialization substantially reduced generated main-kernel instructions but did not produce a stable CUDA Graph or containing-region win, so generic instruction count was not the binding limit.

approaches.summary: Published TMA coordinates before scale and valid-mask preparation so raw and RoPE producer warps could issue earlier.
approaches.why: Exact correctness held, but the extra handoff did not clear the mandatory graph and containing-region gates in either bucket.

approaches.summary: Reordered adjacent NoPE shared-memory column visits across eight-lane consumer groups without changing the mathematical layout.
approaches.why: The generated address work increased and the paired graph evidence was neutral or regressive.

approaches.summary: Replaced the generic float unpack and repack sequence with direct packed E4M3x2-to-BF16x2 PTX behind a goal-local instantiation macro.
approaches.why: The intended Blackwell SASS lowering was present and exact, but its instruction reduction did not survive every graph and region estimator.

approaches.summary: Changed the one-pass raw and RoPE TMA gather cache hints from evict-last to evict-first.
approaches.why: The cache-hint change was visible in generated code but did not create a reproducible graph benefit.

approaches.summary: Swapped the raw NoPE and RoPE producer warp assignments while preserving both gather streams.
approaches.why: Both decode buckets regressed in graph estimators, so producer-slot order was not the missing overlap.

approaches.summary: Specialized top-k, page size, no-extra-KV, and no-attention-sink branches while retaining invalid-index handling and scheduler splits.
approaches.why: Removing generic branches, loads, divisions, and extra-KV code left graph and containing-region performance below the promotion gate.

approaches.summary: Combined the disjoint conversion and exact-contract changes in one prefixed V32 main with the unchanged stock combine.
approaches.why: The composite passed all leaf, containing, stream, graph-mutation, adversarial, and topology checks, but graph gains were unstable and containing eager regressed.

lesson: For short SM100 sparse FlashMLA decode, a large static instruction reduction is not sufficient evidence of a serving win; gate on alternating CUDA Graph replay and the actual containing dispatch region. Preserve the proven one-SM TMA, TMEM, tcgen05, and mbarrier pipeline unless a concrete traffic or synchronization model predicts a benefit.
transfers_to: SM100 sparse FP8 FlashMLA decode with split-KV and a fixed combine
short CUDA Graph serving paths where eager output ownership can mimic a kernel win
goal-local PTX specializations that need generated-SASS and exact-topology evidence
provider integrations that must fail closed on an exact shape and layout ABI
caveats: This serving-native campaign has no frozen evaluate_task.py result.json or audit_result.py verdict; the committed paired timing JSON and immutable timing audit are the measurement authority, and no frozen-task win is claimed.
Measurements were captured from dirty dedicated worktrees, but every retained result binds the exact source closure and binary hash and the cited final local commits contain those same bytes.
Each timing file paired stock and candidate on one leased GPU; the complete campaign used two otherwise identical B200 devices, so no unpaired cross-device ratio was used.
The host has only four GPUs and no target checkpoint, so checkpoint-backed TP8/DP8/EP8 acceptance remains external; the failed local gates mean this result is not an external-acceptance candidate.
The broad serving-native selftest and harness verifier retain unrelated base-state contract drift documented in the final report; goal-scoped tests and evidence audits pass.
No candidate bucket is enabled, and the default-off profile leaves installed stock FlashMLA active.
